_meta.description: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003 — Rules applicable to Mixed-Use Buildings (Ground Commercial + Upper Residential)

rules.title: Minimum Plot Area for Mixed Use
rules.error_message: Plot area {actual} sqm is below the minimum {expected} sqm required for mixed-use developments.
rules.recommendation: Mixed-use developments require at least 200 sqm to accommodate dual commercial and residential requirements.
rules.explanation: Mixed-use developments require adequate plot area to segregate commercial and residential entry points and parking.

rules.title: Minimum Road Width for Mixed Use
rules.error_message: Abutting road width {actual} m is below minimum {expected} m for mixed-use access.
rules.recommendation: Provide at least 12.0 m road width for commercial customer and resident vehicular access.
rules.explanation: Ensures traffic flow and parking queue clearance on public roads.
